name: pii-guard
description: Holds prompts, @file contents and Read results that contain PII or secrets behind a review pane with per-type allow/redact decisions.

policyFile.title: Policy file
policyFile.description: Path to an organisation policy JSON (watchlist, allowlist, type states, custom types, scanToolReads) that is overlaid on this user's settings and locked. Leave empty for none.

policyJson.title: Policy (inline JSON)
policyJson.description: An organisation policy as a JSON string, for managed settings without a file to distribute. Same keys as the policy file; merged with policyFile when both are set.
